# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.10

This developer prerelease lets a host open an artifact once and share that open
across its runtime and its own views. The public query operations remain
`verify`, `search`, `read`, `check`, and `status`.

## Changes

- `openSourceNativeHistoricalProductRuntime(options, adapter, openedState)`,
  and `openSourceNativeProductWithAdmittedKnowledge` /
  `openSourceNativeProductWithConstruction` with `historical: true` and
  `openedState`, reuse an exact state instead of reopening every pack. Only
  states returned by `openExactProductArtifactState` in the same process are
  accepted, and the artifact digest at `options.artifactRoot` must match.
- The file object envelope checks base64 canonicity by length instead of
  re-encoding; the envelope hash already covers the exact string. About 10%
  less open time.

## Install

```sh
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.10/oont-0.3.0-alpha.10.tgz
```
